_meta.source: Dine On Campus, dineoncampus.com/uchicago (apiv4.dineoncampus.com item objects, read in a browser session on 2026-10-28 across the menus of 2026-10-26..2026-11-01 for Baker / Bartlett / Woodlawn / Cathey)
_meta.unit: kcal and protein_g per one official serving (`portion`) of the named item
_meta.verified: 2026-10-28: Scrambled Eggs, Meatless Vegetarian Sausage Patty, Maple Smoked Beef and Pork Sausage, Tater Tots checked against the site's own nutrition panels (portion / kcal / protein all match)
caveats: Item catalog only. The per-day, per-station lists the API returns to a plain browser fetch are scrambled (items from other days/halls mixed in), so they were discarded instead of shipped; which hall / day an item appears on is NOT recorded.
72 rows with no protein value (a bagel/coffee retail brand inside Bartlett, hex ids) were dropped: without protein they cannot feed the ¢/g metric.
Cathey returned empty menus all week; it is selectable but falls back to visual estimate like any hall when nothing matches.
Not reachable from a server: Cloudflare blocks non-browser clients and there is no CORS. Refresh by hand, see data/dining/README.md.
